Done: the issue's done sentence, the test that holds it, and any new dependency.

Guards: each guard test, with the verdict
`python tools/prove_test_fails_before.py <testfile> -k <expr>` printed; a behavior no test reaches,
with the one check that reaches it.

Line delta by area: the three lines `python tools/line_delta.py <repo> main..` printed.

Design issue: its number, when this changes a persisted format, a refusal, an operating-point
stamp or a delivery gate.
